newsitem.title: USA: Renaissance, Doubletree up ratio in merger.
newsitem.headline: Renaissance, Doubletree up ratio in merger.

text.p: Renaissance Hotel Group NV and Doubletree Corp said Monday their boards have approved a memorandum of understanding raising the exchange ratio in their merger.
Renaissance holders will receive $8 cash and 0.4342 Doubletree common shares in the deal. The ratio was 0.4105 when the companies announced the merger January 1.
Based on Friday's close of $43 per Doubletree share, the total consideration would be $26.67 per share.
Doubletree shares were off 1/4 at 42-3/4 Monday morning.
The companies also said that they have agreed to a break-up fee of $15 million. The fee had been $50 million when the merger was announced in January.
The companies said the exchange ratio will be fixed at 0.4342 unless Doubletree falls below $40.3875 per share or rises above $49.3625 for a specific period before the deal closes.
The deal is now valued at about $890 million, including the assumption of $70 million of net debt, the companies said.
